On March 27, 2026, Optimism saw significant progress in refining L2 contract architecture and access control, with multiple issues related to `L2ProxyAdmin` and `L2CM` being closed across several repositories. Concurrently, the `optimism` repository focused on enhancing L2 contract functionality with new feature flags, improving fault proof mechanisms, and migrating extensive documentation to Mintlify, while the `infra` team refactored the `proxyd` component for improved efficiency.

## ✅ Completed Work
### L2 Contract Architecture and Access Control Refinement
*   The `L2CM` specifications were updated to reflect changes in the bundle format and gas allocation handling in `ethereum-optimism/specs` ([#897](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/897)).
*   The issue concerning the refactoring of `L2ProxyAdmin` to utilize the `Initializable` pattern was closed across `ethereum-optimism/specs` ([#19182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19182)), `ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry` ([#19182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19182)), `ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io` ([#19182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19182)), `ethereum-optimism/infra` ([#19182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19182)), and `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19182](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19182)), with the decision that there was no strong reason to implement this change.
*   The task to add `ProxyAdminOwnedBase` access control to predeploy `initialize()` functions within the `L2CM` was closed across `ethereum-optimism/specs` ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/issues/19313)), `ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry` ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/issues/19313)), `ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io` ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/19313)), and `ethereum-optimism/infra` ([#19313](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/19313)), confirming completion.
*   New feature flags were added to the `L1Block` contract for production system customization in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19668](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19668)).
*   Bug fixes addressed informational findings in the L2 Contracts Manager, including a `code.length` check in `L2ProxyAdmin.upgradePredeploys()` in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19783](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19783)).
*   Specifications for the L2 Contracts Manager were updated to include OZ slot clearing details and downgrade prevention invariants in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19774](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19774)).

### Infrastructure and Client Updates
*   Prestates for kona-client 1.2.13 were added to the `validation/standard` directory in `ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry` ([#1205](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-registry/pull/1205)).
*   The `proxyd` component in `ethereum-optimism/infra` saw a significant refactoring of its `ConsensusTracker` interface, simplifying it to a `GetState()`/`SetState()` pattern ([#588](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/588)).
*   The `op-devstack` now utilizes EIP-7702 SetCode for OPCM migration delegatecalls, streamlining `migrateSuperRoots` and `addGameTypeForRuntime` operations in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19745](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19745)).
*   A workaround was implemented in `op-supernode` to address an `op-reth` ForkchoiceUpdate rewind edge case by adding a 50ms sleep between back-to-back FCU calls in `RewindToTimestamp` in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19773](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19773)).

### Documentation and Testing Improvements
*   Documentation for Kona, `op-reth`, and `op-alloy` was migrated from Vocs to the unified Mintlify docs, converting 140 MDX files and updating CI configurations in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19778](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19778)).
*   A new weekly CI job was added to run L2 upgrade fork tests against all supported OP Stack chains in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19793](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19793)).
*   Test coverage was improved for `LegacyMintableERC20` by converting hardcoded tests to fuzz tests and adding event emission assertions in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19557](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19557)).
*   Test coverage for `ETHLiquidity` was improved by fixing and fuzzing a test case related to `mint_moreThanAvailableBalance_fails` in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19665](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19665)).
*   A new test was added to verify that the OPCM upgrade function can be called twice without reverting in `ethereum-optimism/optimism` ([#19724](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19724)).
